commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the order of the Xeech-Leel, as a Voh-Vastei. Hist trees are falling sick because the Unbound drain sap. The order wants the Eye of Argonia, a jewel at the Root that could heal every tree, found before Cuts-the-Old-Knot gets it. 2. Find the dealer selling an Eye of Argonia in Gideon market. The marker points to Ovinius Calo, and there is an Eye of Argonia (Glass) here. 3. I can talk to Ovinius Calo, and look at the Eye. I do not yet know of other options. Quiet approaches are favoured. 4. The Eye here is marked Glass, so it may be a fake. I do not know that for sure. I can find out by talking to Calo and examining it. The marker to Rootworm Landing is also unclear to me.

answer 1. The Eye at the stall is only cheap glass garnet. The real lead is the old silver setting it came in, which the smugglers kept to melt. Unbound and someone called the Collector have also been asking after it. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka and want to find the real Eye and the Root. 2. Go to Gideon South Watch, a leaning tower south-east of the quay, and take the silver setting from the smugglers locked chest in the inner room. 3. Fight the smugglers, or slip past them quietly (I favour quiet). Pick the chest lock, or take the key from the smuggler boss. 4. I do not know who the Collector is, nor why the setting matters. Maybe the setting has markings that point to the real Eye. I could ask around or examine the setting.

answer 1. I stole the boss key without a fight and took the old silver setting from the chest. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, had already opened it and left a note saying a ships name is scratched inside the band. That may lead toward the real Eye. 2. Bring the setting to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom, by the rootworm from Gideons Hist garden. 3. Go straight to Nesh-Deeka as told. I could also read the note and examine the band myself first, or take the note too. 4. I do not know who Ennodius Vanin really is or what he wants. I do not know which ship is named. I can read the note and the setting, and ask Nesh-Deeka.

answer 1. Notes for a friend picking up my save: I am a Voh-Vastei of the Toh-Reel-Ka, working for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. The Eye of Argonia in Gideon was cheap glass, sold by Ovinius Calo, who got it from smugglers at Gideon South Watch. I took the key from the smuggler boss by pickpocket (I have no lockpicks), opened the chest and took the Old Silver Setting and the Collectors Note. The note is from Ennodius Vanin, the Collector, who hunts the real stone. The name scratched in the band is the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight with a Gideon dealers whole stock aboard. Nesh-Deeka paid 100 gold and gave the setting back, so I still carry it. She says the Unbound were in Gideon asking after the glass; she says only we listen. 2. The next lead is the wreck of the Pale Harvest in Hatandros Bight; no objective is set yet, so I would ask Nesh-Deeka. 3. Go to the wreck, or ask Nesh-Deeka or the Collector. 4. I do not know where Hatandros Bight is exactly, how Nesh-Deeka knows what the Unbound do, or what the Collector wants. I still lack lockpicks.

answer The Eye at Gideon was glass. I took the Old Silver Setting from the smugglers chest at Gideon South Watch (pickpocketed the boss key, no fight) along with the Collectors Note from Ennodius Vanin, a rival hunter of the real stone. Inside the band is scratched the Pale Harvest, a Company freighter sunk in Hatandros Bight with a Gideon dealers whole stock aboard: that is the next lead to the real Eye. Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom read it, paid me 100 gold (now about 300 plus) and returned the setting. I carry the setting, the note and the boss key. I have no lockpicks. The Unbound also hunt the glass Eye. Next step: ask Nesh-Deeka about Hatandros Bight and the wreck; I do not yet know where it is.
